resolved_blockers.measured_before: [DIAG-NOTICE] inv=…chat-b#2 boundary=1 cursor=2 reached=2 views=0；[DIAG-ASSEMBLE] prefix=1 total=2 limit=1024（0=history_summary 816B, 1=feedback 62B）
